gcp.artifactregistry.storage.note: Storage, the same for regional and multi-regional repositories; the free 0.5 GB is ignored. From the pricing page; sync verifies it against the Billing Catalog once credentials are set.

gcp.artifactregistry.transfer.note: Data transfer from a repository to Google Cloud in another location: within North America, Europe or Asia, between continents (excluding Oceania), or to or from Oceania. Within one location it is free. From the pricing page. No sync spec: one SKU filter cannot tell the routes apart, so a table sync would write one price into every row.
